app_lets_you: 有些人很難聽到-完全沒有自己的過錯。自閉症，腦癱，唐氏綜合症，安格曼綜合症和瑞特綜合症等殘障人士使許多人難以獨自交流。稱為增強和替代通信（AAC）的強大軟件可以填補空白，並使每個聲音都能聽到。 [[ Some people are hard to hear -- through no fault of their own. Disabilities like autism, cerebral palsy, Down syndrome, Angelman syndrome and Rett syndrome make it harder for many individuals to communicate on their own. Powerful software called Augmentative and Alternative Communication (AAC) can fill the gaps and make every voice heard.
app_lets_you_2: 在%app_name%，我們致力於通過強大的開源技術來幫助那些有復雜溝通需求的人們發聲，該技術可以輕鬆適應個人並支持周圍的所有人，以幫助他們取得成功。 [[ At %app_name% we work to help bring out the voices of those with complex communication needs through powerful open-source technology that easily adapts to the individual and supports everyone around them trying to help them succeed.

offline_text: 借助雲中的備份功能，因此在出現故障時切換設備非常輕鬆。您還可以與其他人共享木板，並向他們開放許可以供任何人使用。 [[ with backup in the cloud so it's painless to switch devices if something breaks. You can also share boards with others and open-license them for anyone to use.

speech_synthesis_info: 大多數現代的網絡瀏覽器都實現了語音合成引擎，該引擎可用於將文本轉換為語音。 [[ Most modern web browsers implement a Speech Synthesis engine that can be used to turn text into speech.

speech_synthesis_info2: 如果您的設備支持語音合成，則默認情況下應安裝一個或多個語音。有時，聲音可能會“丟失”並停止出現在設備上。 [[ If your device supports Speech Synthesis, it should have one or more voices installed by default. Sometimes voices can get "lost" and stop appearing on the device.
file_uploads_info: 並非所有瀏覽器都支持%app_name%使用的現代文件上傳功能。如果您的設備不支持，那麼大多數現代桌面瀏覽器都應該可以上傳。 [[ Not all browsers support the modern file uploading features that %app_name% uses. If your device doesn't, most modern desktop browsers should upload just fine.
file_storage_info: 設備和某些瀏覽器允許您存儲文件以供脫機使用。如果此功能不可用，則某些文件可以存儲在數據庫中，但是您可能會遇到存儲錯誤。 [[ Devices and some browsers allow you to store files for offline use. If this feature is not available, some files can be stored in the database but you may run into storage errors.
indexed_db_info: IndexedDB是用於下載電路板和電路板內容的存儲工具，因此即使沒有Internet連接，%app_name%仍然可以工作。如果設備的內存已滿，有時這些數據庫將被自動（並且意外地）刪除。 [[ IndexedDB is a storage tool used to download boards and board contents so that %app_name% can still work even without an Internet connection. If the device's memory gets full sometimes these databases will be automatically (and unexpectedly) deleted.
sqlite_info: SQLite是另一個用於下載電路板和電路板內容的存儲工具，因此即使沒有Internet連接，%app_name%仍然可以工作。 SQLite數據庫在許多設備上均不可用，但未經許可不會被刪除。 [[ SQLite is another storage tool used to download boards and board contents so that %app_name% can still work even without an Internet connection. SQLite databases aren't available on as many devices, but won't get deleted without permission.
media_recording_info: 媒體錄製允許您使用設備的網絡攝像頭拍照和錄製音頻。某些移動設備使用自己的內置媒體錄製工具，而不是%app_name%的錄製器。 [[ Media Recording allows you to take pictures and record audio using your device's webcam. Some mobile devices use their own built-in media recording tools instead of %app_name%'s recorders.
xhr_cors_info: 為了脫機工作，%app_name%需要從多個網站下載圖像。 XHR / CORS不需要此功能，但是它使下載過程更有效。 [[ In order to work offline, %app_name% needs to download images from multiple web sites. XHR/CORS is not required for this to work, but it makes the download process more efficient.
canvas_info: %app_name%使您可以對圖像進行裁剪和著色以更好地滿足您的電路板要求，並且使用稱為Canvas的元素來實現此目的。 [[ %app_name% lets you crop and colorize images to better match your board requirements, and it uses something called the Canvas element to make that happen.

Just like with spoken communication, it often takes a lot of modeled communication before a communicator gets comfortable on their own, so look for many opportunities to model in different environments and times of day.

inflections_tips: TIPS：有些詞有多種類型。一些替代類型是如此模糊，以至於它們不值得包括在內，想想普通演講者可能會說什麼。如果單詞已經變形（“look”），請確保在第一個框中輸入其詞根（“look”）。某些動詞/副詞的一些變形沒有意義，請在方框中填上“N/A”。對於對立面，只要做最明顯的（如果有的話）。如果您不確定某個單詞，不要害怕跳過它！ [[ TIPS: Some words have multiple types. Some alternate types are so obscure that they're not really worth including, think about what an average speaker might say. If the word is alreeady inflected ("looking") make sure to enter its root ("look") in the first box. Some inflections for certain verbs/adverbs don't make sense, please put "N/A" in the box. For opposites, just do the most obvious if any. If you're unsure about a word, don't be afraid to skip it!

trends_explainer: %app_name% 用戶可以選擇記錄他們的使用數據，以供個人和團隊分析和參考。每當有人選擇加入數據記錄時，我們還會詢問他們是否願意與獨立研究人員分享其使用數據的匿名記錄。我們與非營利研究組織合作，對這些數據進行匯總分析，以更好地了解 AAC 的使用情況，並研究如何改進支持。 [[ %app_name% users can opt-in to recording their usage data for personal and team analysis and reference. Whenever someone opts-in to data logging, we also ask if they would be willing to share an anonymized record of their usage data with independent researchers. We collaborate with non-profit research organizations to analyze this data in aggregate to provide better insights into AAC use and to investigate how supports can be improved.
trends_explainer2: 如果您有興趣進行 AAC 研究，請考慮與我們聯繫以了解有關此重要項目的更多信息。以下是可以匿名和匯總收集的數據類型的一些示例，以幫助 AAC 研究。所有單詞使用信息僅基於選擇匿名研究和報告的用戶的匯總數據。 [[ If you are interested in conducting AAC research, please consider reaching out to us to learn more about this important project. Below are some examples of the types of data that can be collected, anonymously and in aggregate, to help aid AAC research. All word usage information is based on aggregate data only from users who have opted in to anonymized research and reporting.

usage_1: %app_name% 是一個生成語音的工具。您可以點擊按鈕說出單詞或句子，或拼寫單詞。 [[ %app_name% is a tool for generating speech. You can hit buttons to speak words or sentences, or to spell words.
usage_2: %app_name% 不僅適用於非語言交流者。一些溝通者仍在學習，或者只是在某些時候需要幫助，並且擁有像 %app_name% 這樣的 AAC“拐杖”可能是一個很好的支持工具。 [[ %app_name% isn't just for nonverbal communicators. Some communicators are still learning, or need help only some of the time, and having an AAC "crutch" like %app_name% can be a great support tool.
usage_3: %app_name% 可以在任何系統上運行。您可以在主要應用商店中免費下載它，或者安裝 Windows 應用程序或在 Web 瀏覽器中使用它。使用您喜歡的任何設備。 [[ %app_name% can run on any system. You can find it in the major app stores as a free download, or install the Windows app or use it in your web browser. Use whatever device you like.
usage_4: 有些人擔心使用 AAC 的交流者永遠不會自己說話。然而，最近的研究表明，許多 AAC 用戶在他們更加舒適或熟練後就會轉向語音交流。 [[ Some people worry that communicators who use AAC will never speak on their own. However, recent research has shown that many AAC users move on to vocal communication once they are more comfortable or proficient.
picking_a_home_board: 選擇一個家庭板 [[ Picking a Home Board
home_boards_1: 每個人都是獨一無二的，所以通常每個溝通者的詞彙集對他們來說也是獨一無二的。使用 %app_name%，您可以選擇一個入門套件（或構建您自己的套件），並一遍又一遍地對其進行個性化設置。 [[ Everyone is unique, so often each communicator's vocabulary set will be unique to them too. With %app_name% you can pick a starter set (or build your own), and personalize it over and over again.
home_boards_2: 重要的是要考慮到最終的計劃。如果一個溝通者似乎能夠發展成一個大詞彙量，而不是從少量按鈕開始並隨著時間的推移添加更多，從大量按鈕開始並隱藏一些按鈕可能更容易按鈕開始。 [[ The important thing is to plan with the end in mind. If a communicator seems like they'll be able to grow into a large vocabulary, instead of starting with a small number of buttons and adding more over time, it may be easier to start with a large number of buttons and just hide some of the buttons to start out.
supervisors_1: 在%app_name%中，圍繞傳播者的支持團隊被稱為“主管”。主管是為溝通者建模並與之一起工作的用戶。他們有自己的登錄名，可能是老師或治療師、父母、照顧者等。 [[ In %app_name%, the support team around the communicator are called "supervisors". Supervisors are users that are modeling for and working with a communicator. They have their own login, and might be a teacher or a therapist, a parent, a caregiver, etc.
supervisors_2: 主管被添加到他們的溝通者帳戶中，並且可以在他們自己的設備上查看溝通者的板，因此他們可以熟悉用戶的詞彙以更好地建模，並且如果他們具有編輯權限，則可以添加新的按鈕和短語。 [[ Supervisors are added to their communicator's account, and can see a communicator's boards on their own devices, so they can get comfortable with a user's vocabulary for better modeling, and can add new buttons and phrases if they have editing permission.
modeling_on_boards: 在板上建模 [[ Modeling on Boards
boards_1: %app_name% 帶有許多不同風格的板子。當您使用不同的傳播者時，您可能會遇到不同的板樣式和佈局。每個溝通者都可以從他們周圍的支持者示範如何使用 %app_name% 中受益 [[ %app_name% comes with many different styles of boards. As you work with different communicators you may come across different board styles and layouts. Every communicator can benefit from having the supporters around them model how to use %app_name%
board_2: 建模是語言學習的好工具。研究表明，有人為他們建模的 AAC 用戶在採用和使用 AAC 進行交流方面取得了更大的成功。 [[ Modeling is a great tool to language learning. Research has shown that AAC users who have people modeling for them have better success adopting and communicating using AAC.
board_3: 建模很簡單！您所做的只是在與通訊器交談時按下屏幕上的按鈕。向他們展示如何使用可用的按鈕來表達自己。不要只是模擬請求，模擬各種不同的想法、想法、觀察和問題！您建模的越多，您為傳播者提供的示例就越多，說明您認為使用他們的設備的有效方式。 [[ Modeling is easy! All you do is hit buttons on the screen as you talk to the communicator. Show them how they can use the buttons they have available to express themselves. Don't just model requests, model all kinds of different thoughts, ideas, observations, and questions! The more you model, the more examples you'ree giving the communicator for what you consider valid ways of using their device.
boards_explainer: 在 %app_name% 中，詞彙集由“板”的集合組成。您可以選擇多種不同類型的板，具體取決於通信器的功能級別和需求。當你找到你喜歡的，點擊“Make This My Home Board”，讓它成為交流者的“主頁”，這是交流者每次首次加載應用程序時都會看到的內容。 [[ In %app_name% vocabulary sets are made up of a collection of "boards". There are a number of different types of boards you can choose from, depending on the functional level and needs of your communicator. When you find one you like, hit "Make This My Home Board" to make it the communicator's "home board", which is what the communicator will see every time they first load the app.
easy_to_change_later: 緊張你會選錯板？別擔心！您可以在以後輕鬆更改內容。 [[ Nervous you'll pick the wrong board? Don't fret! You can easily change things later.

a_little_about_core: 一點關於核心 [[ A Little About Core
core_1: AAC 的一個重要概念是“核心”詞。核心詞是我們在日常交流中經常使用的詞，可以有多種含義。核心詞可以幫助成長中的溝通者學會一整天的溝通，而不僅僅是在一兩種情況下。 [[ One important concept with AAC is "core" words. Core words are words we use often in everyday communication, and can have multiple meanings. Core words can help growing communicators learn to communicate throughout their day, instead of just in one or two situations.
core_2: 想像一下，如果您只能說“我餓了”、“我累了”或“讓我們再做一次”這樣的預定義短語。你會怎麼問別人他們的一天？你怎麼說你不喜歡某事？我們可以教他們使用核心詞構建自己的短語，而不是試圖思考溝通者可能需要的所有可能的短語。 [[ Imagine if all you could say were predefined phrases like "I'm hungry", "I'm tired", or "Let's do that again." How would you ask someone about their day? How would you say you didn't like something? Instead of trying to think of all possible phrases a communicator might need, we can teach them to build their own phrases using core words.
core_3: 記住要以最終為目的進行計劃，並找到一個包含足夠核心詞的詞彙集，以供交流者成長。 [[ Remember to plan with the end in mind, and find a vocabulary set with enough core words for the communicator to grow into.

voice_as_fallback: 如果您打算錄製消息，則此語音將僅用於未附加錄音的任何按鈕，或用於使用鍵盤手動拼寫的單詞。 [[ If you're planning to record messages, this voice will only be used for any buttons that don't have recordings attached to them, or for words that are manually spelled using the keyboard.
supervisors_explainer: %app_name% 與溝通者周圍的支持者團隊合作效果最佳。每個用戶都可以擁有自己的 %app_name% 帳戶（支持者是免費的），傳播者可以通過將團隊成員添加為“主管”來將他們連接到他們的帳戶。 [[ %app_name% works best with a team of supporters around the communicator. Every user can have their own %app_name% account (supporters are free), and communicators can connect team members to their account by adding them as "supervisors".
get_added_as_supervisor: 為了查看與您合作的溝通者的看板和報告，這些用戶需要從他們的儀表板中添加您。您可以鼓勵他們將溝通者周圍的每個人都添加為主管，以幫助建立強大的支持團隊。 %app_name% 提供免費的建模專用帳戶，以幫助每個人參與！ [[ In order to see the boards and reports for communicators you work with, those users need to add you from their dashboard. You can encourage them to add everyone around the communicator as supervisors to help build a strong support team. %app_name% offers free modeling-only accounts to help everyone get involved!
add_lots_of_supervisors: 學習 AAC 最適合傳播者周圍的許多支持者。您可以鼓勵家人、老師、治療師等人註冊免費的支持者帳戶，然後將他們添加為主管，以授予對董事會、報告和目標的訪問權限。 [[ Learning AAC works best with lots of supporters around communicator. You can encourage people like family members, teachers, therapists, etc. to sign up for a free supporter account, and then add them as supervisors to grant access to boards, reports and goals.
add_of_manage_supervisors: 添加或管理主管 [[ Add or Manage Supervisors
accessing_linked_boards: 訪問鏈接板 [[ Accessing Linked Boards
folders_1: 在角落有一個小文件夾圖標或標記的按鈕是鏈接按鈕，這意味著如果您選擇它們，它將帶您到另一個板。這使您可以擁有多個級別，其中包含比單個屏幕上容納的更多的單詞和短語。你總是可以通過點擊主頁按鈕回到第一個板。 [[ Buttons that have a little folder icon or a mark in the corner are linked buttons, which means that if you select them it will take you to another board. This lets you have multiple levels, with more words and phrases than could fit on a single screen. You can always get back to the first board by hitting the home button.
folders_2: 默認情況下，鏈接按鈕不說話，當通信器點擊非鏈接按鈕時，它們將被帶回主控板，但這兩個設置都是可選的，可以在用戶的偏好中更改。 [[ By default linked buttons do not speak, and when the communicator hits a non-linked button they will be taken back to the home board, but both of these settings are optional and can be changed in a user's preferences.

access_selection_action: 當通訊器選擇一個按鈕時會發生什麼？ [[ What happens when the communicator selects a button?
home_return_1: 當選擇一個按鈕時，%app_name% 將自動返回主板。這有助於為每個按鈕制定一致的順序（稱為電機計劃），因此我們建議將其作為默認設置，但您可以根據需要進行更改。 [[ When a button is selected %app_name% will automatically return to the home board. This helps develop a consistent sequence for each button (called a motor plan), so we recommend it as the default but you can change it if needed.
return_to_the_home_board: 返回主局 [[ Return to the Home Board
stay_on_the_current_board: 留在當前董事會 [[ Stay on the Current Board
touch_access: 觸摸訪問%app_name% [[ touch access to %app_name%
touch_1: 觸摸或單擊按鈕是 %app_name% 等通訊板最常見的訪問方法。通過點擊或點擊按鈕，溝通者可以在板之間導航並選擇單詞或短語讓系統為他們說話。 [[ Touching or clicking buttons is the most common access method for communication boards like those in %app_name%. By tapping or clicking on buttons, communicators can navigate between boards and select words or phrases to have the system speak for them.
touch_2: 一些溝通者需要額外的調整，例如根據他們抬起手指的位置、更大的文本或按鈕之間更大的間隙進行選擇。這些都可以從 %app_name% 內的用戶“首選項”視圖中進行配置。 [[ Some communicators need additional accommodations, like selecting based on where they lift their finger, bigger text, or larger gaps between buttons. These are all configurable from a user's "Preferences" view inside of %app_name%.
scanning_access: 掃描訪問 %app_name% [[ scanning access in %app_name%
scanning_1: 一些傳播者有運動控制問題，這使得他們很難點擊屏幕上的小按鈕。如果他們可以擊中更大的目標，如藍牙或稱為“開關”的連接按鈕，甚至只是擊中屏幕，那麼 %app_name% 可以將板分成越來越小的塊，一次“掃描”它們，然後等待供用戶使用他們的開關進行選擇。 [[ Some communicators have motor control issues which make it hard for them to hit small buttons on a screen. If they can hit larger targets like a bluetooth or connected button called a "Switch", or even just hit the screen, then %app_name% can break the board up into smaller and smaller chunks, "scan" through them one at a time, and wait for the user to select using their switch.
scanning_2: %app_name% 可以按行、列或自定義區域進行掃描，甚至可以使用不同的聲音或音量進行掃描，以減少溝通者的困惑。它適用於外部開關，或者您可以將屏幕設置為一個巨大的按鈕，或兩個獨立的按鈕。所有這些設置都在用戶的“首選項”視圖中可用。 [[ %app_name% can scan by row, column, or custom region, and can even use a different voice or volume for scanning to make things less confusing for the communicator. It works with external switches, or you can make the screen a giant button, or two independent buttons. All of these settings are available in a user's "Preferences" view.
dwell_access: 在 %app_name% 中停留訪問 [[ dwell access in %app_name%
dwell_1: 對於沒有一致運動控制的交流者，眼動儀有時可能是一種有效的訪問方法。眼動儀是一種跟踪眼球運動的特殊相機。當通信者的視線停留在按鈕上一段時間時，系統可以代表通信者選擇該按鈕。或者，一些系統可以使用攝像頭或傳感器跟踪聽覺或身體運動，將鼠標光標視為操縱桿，當光標“停留”在按鈕上時，它被選中。眼動或駐留跟踪可能比開關訪問更快，但更難正確校準。 [[ For communicators without consistent motor control, eye trackers can sometimes be an effective access method. An eye tracker is a special camera that tracks eye movements. When a communicator's gaze lingers on a button for a period of time, the system can select that button on behalf of the communicator. Alternatively, some systems can track hear or body movement using cameras or sensors to treat the mouse cursor like a joystick, and when the cursor "dwells" over a button, it is selected. Eye or dwell tracking can be faster than switch access, but is more difficult to calibrate correctly.
dwell_2: %app_name% 可以與任何支持光標控制的眼動儀或系統一起使用（我們已經測試了 Tobii、MyGaze、eyetech 和 LC Technologies 以及 EagleEyes 硬件）。只需禁用“點擊”事件，因為 %app_name% 會自行處理這些事件。您可以在用戶的“首選項”視圖中微調跟踪設置。某些系統，如 EyeTribe 和 EyeX，也需要在“首選項”中進行額外配置。 [[ %app_name% can work with any eye tracker or system that supports cursor control (we have tested Tobii, MyGaze, eyetech and LC Technologies, and EagleEyes hardware). Just disable "click" events since %app_name% handles these on its own. You can fine-tune the tracking settings on the user's "Preferences" view. Some systems, like EyeTribe and EyeX, will require additional configuration in "Preferences" as well.
modeling_1: 當某人正在學習交流時（無論是通過說話還是使用 AAC），重要的是他們有很多支持交流者幫助他們看到好的例子並正確學習。 [[ When someone is learning to communicate (whether by speaking or using AAC), it's important that they have lots of supporting communicators helping them see good examples and learn correctly.
modeling_2: 在 AAC 世界中，許多人稱之為“建模”，重要的是 AAC 用戶周圍的人向他們展示如何有效使用他們的設備的示例（“你想要一個 cookie？讓我告訴你，你可以說*想要*和然後 *cookie*")。 [[ In the AAC world many people call this "modeling", and it's important that people around AAC users are showing them examples of how to effectively use their device ("You want a cookie? Let me show you, you could say *want* and then *cookie*").
modeling_3: 在%app_name%中，如果您三次點擊清除按鈕，您將看到一個指示“建模模式”的手指圖標。當處於建模模式時，%app_name% 跟踪作為建模操作按下的按鈕，因此它們不會顯示在通信器的使用報告中。再次點擊“清除”以退出建模模式。 [[ In %app_name% if you triple-tap the clear button, you'll see a finger icon indicating "Modeling Mode". When in Modeling Mode %app_name% tracks buttons pressed as modeling actions so they don't show up in a communicator's usage reports. Tap "Clear" again to leave Modeling Mode.
extra_reports_1: 主管還可以查看用戶的通信歷史記錄。出於隱私原因，默認情況下禁用日誌和報告，但如果您啟用它們，則用戶的主管可以看到他們的通信隨著時間的推移如何進行。 [[ Supervisors can also review a user's communication history. For privacy reasons logs and reports are disabled by default, but if you enable them then the user's supervisors can see how their communication is progressing over time.
extra_reports_2: 報告包括信息，例如通訊器最常使用的詞、設備在一天中的什麼時間使用，甚至他們在屏幕上點擊的位置。這些信息可以幫助團隊保持協調和完成任務。 [[ Reports include information like what words the communicator is using most often, what time of day the device is being used, and even where on the screen they're hitting. This information can help the team stay coordinated and on task.
extra_home_boards_1: %app_name% 有許多不同的主頁板，您可以立即開始使用，或者隨時復制和個性化。有些板子有幾個大按鈕，有些板子有很多小按鈕。 [[ %app_name% has a number of different home boards that you can start using right away, or copy and personalize as you go. Some boards have a few large buttons, and some have many small buttons.
extra_home_boards_2: 更多的按鈕意味著更多的表達選項，但是一些用戶在他們可以可靠地點擊的按鈕上受到限制（請記住，您現在可以隨時隱藏您想要稍後添加的按鈕，因此看起來“太忙”的板可能實際上是他們可以隨著時間的推移而成長的東西）。 [[ More buttons means more options for expression, but some users are limited in how small a button they can reliably hit (keep in mind you can always hide buttons for now that you want to add later, so a board that looks "too busy" may actually be something they can grow into over time).
intro_1: 感謝您註冊%app_name%！我們很高興您能來到這裡，並希望 %app_name% 對您有所幫助。如果您是 %app_name% 的新手，本演練將幫助您入門。 [[ Thanks for signing up for %app_name%! We're excited you're here and hope %app_name% makes a difference for you. If you're new to %app_name%, this walkthrough will help you get started.
intro_3: 首先，記住您的用戶名（%{un}），您可以在下載免費應用程序時使用它登錄。您還可以在任何帶有網絡瀏覽器的計算機上編輯板子、練習和查看報告！ [[ First, remember your username (%{un}), you can use it to log in when you download the free app. You can also edit boards, practice and view reports from any computer with a web browser!
intro_2: 接下來，我們想教一些關於 AAC（Augmentative and Alternative Communication）的知識，然後幫助確保您正確設置了 %app_name%。點擊底角的“下一步”開始。 [[ Next we'd like to teach just a little about AAC (Augmentative and Alternative Communication), and then help make sure you've got %app_name% set up correctly. Hit "Next" in the bottom corner to get started.

logs_and_notes: 日誌和註釋 [[ Logs and Notes
logs_1: 除了查看使用歷史記錄之外，主管還可以訪問每個通信會話的詳細報告，並可以與用戶的團隊進行記錄和共享，因此每個人都知道當前的策略是什麼，什麼是有效的或無效的。 [[ In addition to reviewing usage history, supervisors can access detailed reports on each communication session, and can make and share notes with the user's team, so everyone knows what the current strategy is and what is or isn't working well.
start_deciding: 除了選擇板外，還有一些其他的設置可以根據溝通者的情況而改變。請記住，您以後可以隨時在“首選項”下更改這些設置。 [[ In addition to selecting a board, there are some other settings that can change based on the communicator's situation. Keep in mind that you can always change these settings later under "Preferences".

logging_1: 當您啟用日誌記錄時，包括按下的按鈕、一天中的時間、屏幕大小和方向等硬件特徵在內的所有信息都會代表您收集並存儲在雲中。其中一些報告使用谷歌圖表來呈現匿名信息，如每天按下的按鈕和按類型劃分的部分語音頻率。此數據用於生成報告以幫助支持團隊跟踪進度並設定有效目標，並且可以隨時禁用。 [[ When you enable logging, information including buttons pressed, time of day, hardware characteristics like screen size and orientation are all collected and stored in the cloud on your behalf. Some of these reports use Google Charts to render anonymized information like buttons pressed per day and parts of speech frequency by type. This data is used to generate reports to help the support team track progress and set effective goals, and can be disabled at any time.
logging_2: 為幫助支持 AAC 研究，%app_name% 使用所有記錄的使用信息的匿名摘要與社區分享一般趨勢。這包括匯總數據，如流行的核心詞、總會話時間和典型的建模頻率。 %app_name% 還與研究機構合作，提供來自啟用匿名研究支持的 %app_name% 用戶的匿名通信信息。不會共享用戶個人資料和可識別信息，但可能會公開發布匿名數據，如果您不喜歡與公共研究人員共享此用戶的 AAC 通信，您可以在此處或在用戶的偏好頁面。請注意，選擇加入的非活動用戶在很長一段時間內不會從我們的系統中刪除，以繼續為研究人員提供支持。 [[ To help support research in AAC, %app_name% uses anonymized summaries of all logged usage information to share general trends with the community. This includes summary data like popular core words, total session time and typical frequency of modeling. %app_name% also collaborates with research organizations by providing anonymized communication information from %app_name% users who have enabled anonymous research support. User profiles and identifiable information are not shared, but the anonymized data may be published publicly, and if you're not comfortable sharing this user's AAC communication with public researchers, you can opt out here or on the user's preferences page. Note that inactive users who have opted in will not be deleted from our system for an extended period of time, to continue to provide support to researchers.

logging_3: 此外，如果您願意，%app_name% 可以跟踪 GPS 數據，以便更好地了解用戶通信如何根據位置發生變化。可以從用戶的首選項頁面從系統中手動清除所有記錄數據。如果您想在故障排除時選擇退出聚合數據收集或禁止 %app_name% 管理員查看您的日誌，您可以在用戶的首選項中選擇“完全限制日誌訪問” [[ Additionally, if you'd like, %app_name% can track GPS data to provide better insights into how user communication changes based on location. As you start work with communicators who are using AAC, look for chances to model different words, or the same words in different ways. It may take practice to get comfortable or to see results, but research has shown over and over how much of a different modeling makes!

want_to_fix_that: ——不是因為他們自己的過錯。許多人需要技術的幫助才能讓他們的聲音被聽到。不幸的是，很多這種技術很難使用，很難配置，而且非常昂貴。 %app_name% 是一個新的 AAC 應用程序，它試圖解決這個問題。 [[ -- through no fault of their own. Many people need the assistance of technology in order for their voices to be heard. Unfortunately, a lot of that technology is hard to use, is hard to configure, and is crazy expensive. %app_name% is a new AAC app that tries to fix that.
why_lingolinq: 為什麼選擇「%app_name%」？LingoLinq 這個名字源於將語言與最需要它的人連結起來。我們相信每個人都值得擁有一個聲音——一個易於使用、負擔得起、自然到沒有人會多想的聲音。我們希望為日常使用的複雜溝通需求提供平易近人、簡單的解決方案。 [[ Why ”%app_name%”? The name LingoLinq comes from linking language to the people who need it most. We believe everyone deserves a voice -- one that's easy to use, affordable to access, and so natural that nobody thinks twice about it. We want to provide approachable, simple solutions to complex communication needs that work for everyday use.
the_challenge_text: Some people need help being heard -- and the tools out there? Often clunky, confusing, and way too expensive.
our_mission_text: LingoLinq means linking language to the people who need it most. Everyone deserves a voice that's easy to use, affordable, and just works.
our_mission_closer: That's what LingoLinq is all about.
landing_cta_subtitle_intro: Start with our free tier. No credit card, no hardware, no commitment.
learn_as_you_go: 邊走邊學 [[ Learn as You Go
learn_as_you_go_content_1: 如果您不熟悉增強通信的世界，那麼它的幾乎每個部分都會讓人感到恐懼。您怎麼可能知道為個人的個人需求（以及想要、希望和願望）選擇正確的詞語和符號。不用擔心，我們與許多不同的專家合作，提供經過充分研究的模板，幫助您入門。同樣重要的是，我們為父母、看護人、兄弟姐妹提供培訓資源……參與支持個人的每個人都應該知道發生了什麼，以及他們究竟如何幫助溝通策略取得成功。 [[ If you're new to the world of augmentative communication, just about every part of it feels intimidating. How could you possibly know the right words and symbols to pick for an individual's personal needs (and wants, and hopes, and wishes). Not to worry, we work with many different specialists to provide well-researched templates that will get you started. And just as importantly, we provide training resources for parents, caregivers, siblings... everyone involved in supporting an individual deserves to know what's going on and how exactly they can help the communication strategies be successful.
offline_content_1: 收集數據和跨設備工作非常棒，但仍有很多地方沒有良好的 Wi-Fi 連接。 %app_name% 存儲用戶的板子並在每個設備上登錄，以便用戶可以無中斷地離線通信。下次有互聯網連接時，所有內容都會同步備份。 [[ Gathering data and working across devices is great, but there are still plenty of places where you won't have a good Wi-fi connection. %app_name% stores a user's boards and logs on each device so the user can communicate offline with no interrupts. Everything syncs back up the next time there is an internet connection.
personalization: 個性化和同步 [[ Personalization and Sync
personalization_content_1: 綁定到單個設備是有風險的，尤其是當您添加了許多自己的圖片或移動圖片符號以供個人使用時。您不僅可能會丟失數據和配置，而且如果屏幕破裂或電池沒電了，在更換之前您會很不走運。 %app_name% 可跨多個設備工作，並為您保持內容同步，因此您不必擔心。 [[ Being tied to a single device is risky, especially when you've added lots of your own pictures or moved picture symbols around for personal use. Not only can you possibly lose your data and configuration, but if a screen cracks or a battery dies, you're out of luck until it can be replaced. %app_name% works across multiple devices and keeps content in sync for you so you don't have to worry.
create_share: 創建、共享和重用 [[ Create, Share and Reuse
create_share_content_1: 在創建一組通信板時，沒有人願意從頭開始。 %app_name% 讓您輕鬆發現和個性化他人創建的通訊板。並且 %app_name% 鼓勵內容和符號的開放許可，因此您不必懷疑您是否在某處意外侵犯了版權。 [[ Nobody wants to start from scratch when creating a set of communication boards. %app_name% lets you easily discover and personalize communication boards created by others. And %app_name% encourages open licenses of content and symbols, so you don't have to wonder if you're breaking copyright somewhere on accident.
open_board_support: %app_name% 致力於使板子開放和可重複使用。以至於我們開始了OpenBoards 倡議，致力於為所有應用和設備導入和導出板的標准文件格式，我們使用該格式作為我們的本機導入/導出格式。當我們可以自由地建立彼此的想法和成功，無論他們來自哪裡，每個人都會贏。 [[ %app_name% is committed to making boards open and reusable. So much so that we started the OpenBoards initiative to work toward a standard file format for importing and exporting boards across all apps and devices, and we use that format as our native import/export format. When we have the freedom to build off of each other's ideas and successes regardless of where they came from, everyone wins.
coordination_content_1: 必須將個人的通信設備從他們身邊拿走才能對其進行編程是一件可怕的事情，它會奪走他們的聲音。 %app_name% 讓治療師、專家、父母和其他團隊成員修改通信集，甚至在每個人都可以從中受益的地方記錄會話筆記和消息。 [[ Having to take an individual's communication device away from them in order to program it is a terrible thing, it takes away their voice. %app_name% lets therapists, specialists, parents and other team members modify the communication set and even log session notes and messages in a place where everyone can benefit from them.
insights_content_1: 有時真的很難知道什麼有效，什麼無效。增強交流是一個不斷修改和引入詞彙的過程，如果沒有好的報告，很難確定需要改變什麼。 %app_name% 可以記錄所有通信，並根據時間、地點和詞彙提供有見地的報告，讓每個人都更清楚地知道他們應該在哪裡集中精力以獲得最佳結果。 [[ Sometimes it's really hard to know what's working and what's not. Augmentative communication is an ongoing process of modifying and introducing vocabulary, and without good reports it's difficult to be sure what needs to change. %app_name% can log all communications and provide insightful reports based on time, location and vocabulary that makes it clearer for everyone just where to focus their efforts for the best results.
learn_as_you_go_catchphrase: Expert-designed templates and training so you never start from scratch.
work_offline_catchphrase: Communicate anywhere -- boards and logs sync when you reconnect.
personalization_catchphrase: Your setup follows you across every device, always up to date.
create_share_catchphrase: Discover boards, share openly, and build on each other's work.
coordination_catchphrase: Therapists and families collaborate without taking the device away.
insights_catchphrase: Clear reports that show what's working and where to focus next.
trust_transparency_text: We're talking about someone's voice -- potentially everything they ever say. That's deeply personal, and we treat it that way. Your data is encrypted, never shared without permission, and always yours to export.
security_content_1: %app_name% 提供所有板、日誌和用戶信息的安全通信和存儲。未經明確許可，我們不會共享用戶數據、私人版塊和使用日誌等私人信息。我們非常重視用戶隱私，因為歸根結底，我們所說的可能是記錄個人所說的一切。這類信息值得保護。 [[ %app_name% provides secure communication and storage of all boards, logs and user information. We do not share private information like user data, private boards and usage logs without explicit permission. We take user privacy extremely seriously because, at the end of the day, what we're talking about is potentially recording everything an individual ever says. That kind of information deserves to be protected.
open_source_content_1: 大多數 AAC 系統都建立在專有技術之上，這意味著您並不真正了解它們的安全性，更容易被鎖定並被迫採用它們的做事方式。 %app_name% 是開源的並以開放的心態構建，因此您可以親眼看到系統中的內容，並且您始終可以輕鬆訪問和導出所有數據。 [[ Most AAC systems are built on proprietary technology, which means you don't really know how secure they are, it's easier to get locked in and forced into their way of doing things. %app_name% is open source and built with an open mindset, so you can see for yourself what goes into the system, and you always have easy access and exports for all your data.

robust_1: 強大的詞彙起初可能看起來有點嚇人，但它們可以是強大的語言集，交流者可以隨著時間的推移而成長。嘗試更多地關注通信器可以成功訪問的按鈕數量，而不是屏幕的繁忙程度，因為您始終可以隱藏按鈕併計劃稍後重新啟用它們。這些板集可以強調運動規劃或務實的溝通，但都具有很好的核心和專業詞彙集合，以及個性化詞彙的空間。 [[ Robust vocabularies may seem a little intimidating at first, but they can be powerful language sets that the communicator can grow into over time. aac_intro_1: 感謝您註冊%app_name%！我們很高興您能來到這裡，並希望 %app_name% 有所作為。在我們了解一些 %app_name% 的基礎知識之前，我們想談談 AAC。 [[ Thanks for signing up for %app_name%! We're excited you're here and hope %app_name% makes a difference. Before we get into some %app_name% basics, we wanted to talk a little about AAC.
aac_intro_2: AAC（Augmentative and Alternative Communication）是一種幫助培養溝通者被傾聽的工具。 %app_name% 是一種 AAC，您可以在其中選擇代表單詞或字母的按鈕，並且設備會說出用戶選擇的任何內容。 [[ AAC (Augmentative and Alternative Communication) is a tool to help developing communicators be heard. %app_name% is a type of AAC where you select buttons that represent words or letters and the device speaks whatever the user selects.
aac_board_examples: AAC 板示例 [[ AAC Board Examples
aac_intro_22: AAC 可以為那些難以自言自語的人帶來巨大的改變。理想情況下，用戶可以從字典中的任何單詞中選擇，但如果拼寫不是一種選擇，我們需要仔細選擇正確的單詞和短語，以最好地幫助每個人有效地進行交流。 [[ AAC can make a huge difference for people who have a hard time speaking on their own. Ideally users could pick from any word in the dictionary, but if spelling isn't an option, we need to carefully choose the right words and phrases to best help each individual communicate effectively.
aac_intro_3: 在 %app_name% 中，我們將單詞和短語放在按鈕上，這些按鈕被組織為“板”的集合。對於許多不同的用戶和需求，有不同的板組。 [[ In %app_name% we put words and phrases on buttons that are organized as a collection of "boards". There are different board sets for many different users and needs.
choosing_vocabulary: 選擇正確的詞彙 [[ Choosing the Right Vocabulary
core_words_1: 用正確的詞開始一個用戶很重要——而且很難！你如何決定哪些詞應該觸手可及？ [[ Starting a user with the right words is important -- and hard! How do you decide which words someone should have at their fingertips?
core_words_2: 許多人首先想到的是基於需求的溝通（“我需要去洗手間”、“我很受傷”、“我餓了”），而這些都是能夠表達的重要內容。但是，嘗試包含可以以多種方式使用的常用詞也非常有價值。我們稱這些類型的詞為“核心”詞。 [[ Many people think first about needs-based communication ("I need to go to the bathroom", "I am hurting", "I am hungry"), and these are important things to be able to express. However, it's also very valuable to try to include common words that can be used in more than one way. We call these types of words "core" words.
core_words_3: 核心詞是“你”、“我”、“喜歡”、“不”、“去”、“在”等詞。它們可能看起來沒有那麼有用，但隨著時間的推移，用戶會接觸到核心詞單詞可以表達許多不同的想法（“我喜歡”、“不想要”、“你明白了”、“我們什麼時候可以去”）並更有效地加深他們的詞彙量。 [[ Core words are words like "you", "I", "like", "not", "go", "in", etc. They may not seem as useful right away, but over time a user who is exposed to core words can express many different ideas ("I like it", "not want", "you get it", "when can we go there") and more effectively deepen their vocabulary.
core_words_4: 每個用戶都是不同的，但核心和專業單詞和短語的組合通常可以幫助溝通者逐漸增加他們的表達，而不是僅僅表達需求和願望。 [[ Every user is different, but a combination of core and specialized words and phrases can often help a communicator grow their expression gradually, instead of being stuck only expressing needs and wants.
selecting_a_home_board: 選擇主板 [[ Selecting a Home Board
home_board_1: %app_name% 有許多不同的主控板，您可以立即開始使用，也可以隨時復制和個性化。有些板子有幾個大按鈕，有些板子有很多小按鈕。 [[ %app_name% has a number of different home boards that you can start using right away, or copy and personalize as you go. Some boards have a few large buttons, and some have many small buttons.
home_board_2: 更多的按鈕意味著更多的表達選項，但是一些用戶在他們可以可靠地點擊的按鈕上受到限制（請記住，您現在可以隨時隱藏您想要稍後添加的按鈕，因此看起來“太忙”的板可能實際上是他們可以隨著時間的推移而成長的東西）。 [[ More buttons means more options for expression, but some users are limited in how small a button they can reliably hit (keep in mind you can always hide buttons for now that you want to add later, so a board that looks "too busy" may actually be something they can grow into over time).
speak_mode_2: 當您處於說話模式時，您可以點擊按鈕讓它們說話，並添加到頂部的發聲框中。如果您點擊發聲框，它將說出位於那裡的所有按鈕。退格和清除按鈕可以幫助保持句子窗口清潔。 [[ When you're in Speak Mode you can hit buttons to have them spoken, and added to the vocalization box at the top. If you hit the vocalization box it'll speak all the buttons that are located there. The backspace and clear buttons can help keep the sentence window clean.
app_speak_mode_folders: %app_name% 朗讀模式文件夾 [[ %app_name% Speak Mode Folders
speak_mode_22: 上面有一個小文件夾圖標的按鈕是鏈接按鈕，這意味著如果您選擇它們，它將帶您到另一個板。這使您可以擁有多個級別，其中包含比單個屏幕上容納的更多的單詞和短語。你總是可以通過點擊主頁按鈕回到第一個板。 [[ Buttons that have a little folder icon on them are linked buttons, which means that if you select them it will take you to another board. This lets you have multiple levels, with more words and phrases than could fit on a single screen. You can always get back to the first board by hitting the home button.
app_exiting_speak_mode: %app_name% 退出說話模式 [[ %app_name% Exiting Speak Mode
speak_mode_3: 您可以通過點擊右上角的用戶菜單退出說話模式。如果您擔心用戶不小心自行退出語音模式，您可以在用戶的首選項中設置 PIN。 [[ You can exit out of Speak Mode by hitting the user menu in the top right corner. If you're worried about a user accidentally exiting Speak Mode on their own, you can set up a PIN in the user's preferences.
intro_modeling_3: 在%app_name%中，圍繞傳播者的支持團隊被稱為“主管”。主管是為溝通者建模並與之一起工作的用戶。他們有自己的登錄名，可能是老師或治療師、父母、照顧者等。 [[ In %app_name%, the support team around the communicator are called "supervisors". Supervisors are users that are modeling for and working with a communicator. They have their own login, and might be a teacher or a therapist, a parent, a caregiver, etc.
intro_modeling_4: 主管被添加到他們的溝通者帳戶中，並且可以在他們自己的設備上查看溝通者的板，因此他們可以熟悉用戶的詞彙以更好地建模，並且如果他們具有編輯權限，則可以添加新的按鈕和短語。 [[ Supervisors are added to their communicator's account, and can see a communicator's boards on their own devices, so they can get comfortable with a user's vocabulary for better modeling, and can add new buttons and phrases if they have editing permission.
logging_and_report: 記錄和報告 [[ Logging and Reports
reports_1: 主管還可以查看用戶的通信歷史記錄。出於隱私原因，默認情況下禁用日誌和報告，但如果您啟用它們，則用戶的主管可以看到他們的通信隨著時間的推移如何進行。 [[ Supervisors can also review a user's communication history. For privacy reasons logs and reports are disabled by default, but if you enable them then the user's supervisors can see how their communication is progressing over time.
app_logs_and_notes: %app_name% 日誌和註釋 [[ %app_name% Logs and Notes
reports_2: 除了查看使用歷史記錄之外，主管還可以訪問每個通信會話的詳細報告，並可以與用戶的團隊進行記錄和共享，因此每個人都知道當前的策略是什麼，什麼是有效的或無效的。 [[ In addition to reviewing usage history, supervisors can access detailed reports on each communication session, and can make and share notes with the user's team, so everyone knows what the current strategy is and what is or isn't working well.

more_resources_2: 如果您迷路了，您可以隨時點擊儀表板底部的“支持”按鈕尋求幫助，或分享有關我們如何改進 %app_name% 的反饋。我們隨時為您提供幫助！ [[ If you ever get lost you can always hit the "Support" button at the bottom of the dashboard to ask for help, or to share feedback on how we can improve %app_name%. We're always here to help!

have_you_tried_modeling: 你試過建模嗎？ [[ Have You Tried Modeling?
modeling_intro_1: 學習使用 AAC 詞彙很像學習一門新語言。當您周圍的人也使用它時，它會容易得多！您可以通過建模來提供幫助，它展示瞭如何使用它的示例（“這就是您可以這樣說的方式”，然後自己點擊按鈕）。有時，在傳播者遵循您的示例之前需要進行大量建模，因此請耐心等待！ [[ Learning to use an AAC vocabulary is a lot like learning a new language. It's much easier when the people around you use it too! You can help by modeling, which is showing examples of how to us it ("here's how you could say this" and then hit the buttons yourself). Sometimes it takes a lot of modeling before a communicator follows your example, so try to be patient!
modeling_intro_2: 建模時，您需要確保您處於建模模式，因此%app_name% 可以區分您的演講和交流者的演講。您可以在儀表板中為通信器“建模”，或者您可以三次點擊清除按鈕以暫時進入建模模式。試一試，親眼看看！ [[ When modeling you'll want to make sure you're in modeling mode, so %app_name% can tell the difference between your speech and the communicator's. You can "model for" a communicator in your dashboard, or you can triple-tap the clear button to temporarily go into modeling mode. Give it a try and see for yourself!
thanks_app: 感謝您在網絡瀏覽器中嘗試 %app_name%！這是您看到的嵌入網站的演示，因此僅限於說話模式，但如果您訪問該網站，您應該能夠像往常一樣訪問您的帳戶。 [[ Thanks for trying %app_name% in your web browser! This is a demo you're seeing embedded in a web site, so it's limited to speak mode only, but if you visit the web site you should be able to access your account as usual.
thanks_app_long: 感謝您在網絡瀏覽器中嘗試 %app_name%！這是一個嵌入在網站中的演示，但 %app_name% 是一個強大的增強通信 (AAC) 應用程序，它可以在桌面瀏覽器中作為自己的選項卡運行，或者在平板電腦上的應用程序商店中下載，智能手機。您可以註冊免費試用，看看它是否適合您或您認識的人！ [[ Thanks for trying %app_name% in your web browser! This is a demo you're seeing embedded in a web site, but %app_name% is a powerful augmentative communication (AAC) app that can run as it's own tab in a browser on a desktop, or be downloaded in app stores on tablets and smartphones. You can sign up for a free trial and see if it will work for you or someone you know!

contact_us_intro: 問題？建議？俳句？我們很樂意聽取您的意見！我們的目標是建立一種資源來支持溝通者和他們周圍的團隊，這樣我們就可以幫助人們聽到人們的聲音。如果沒有您的幫助和參與，我們幾乎無法做到這一點，所以請給我們留言！ [[ Questions? Suggestions? Haikus? We'd love to hear any of them from you! Our goal is to build a resource that supports communicators and the teams around them so we can help people's voices be heard. We can't do that nearly as well without help and participation from you, so please send us a line!

app_partners_and_supported_integrations: %app_name% 合作夥伴和支持的集成 [[ %app_name% Partners and Supported Integrations
compatibility_intro: %app_name% 致力於與其他公司和組織合作，為傳播者提供最佳體驗。以下是我們提供的一些合作夥伴和兼容資源。 [[ %app_name% is committed to working with other companies and organizations to provide communicators with the best possible experience. Here are some of the partners and compatible resources we have available.
community_partners: 社區合作夥伴 [[ Community Partners
community_partners_explainer: 社區合作夥伴是提供輔助技術資源和工具的技術和支持合作夥伴，這些資源和工具還可以使 %app_name% 對某些傳播者及其支持團隊的使用更加有效。 [[ Community partners are technical and support partners that provide assistive technology resources and tools that can also make %app_name% usage more effective for some communicators and their support teams.
frs_explainer: Forbes AAC 與保險合作，為其 ProSlate 專用平板電腦提供資金，並預裝了 %app_name%。 [[ Forbes AAC works with insurance to get their ProSlate dedicated tablet funded with %app_name% pre-installed.
ablenet_explainer: AbleNet 與保險合作，為他們的 QuickTalker FreeStyle 專用平板電腦提供資金，並預裝了 %app_name%。 [[ AbleNet works with insurance to get their QuickTalker FreeStyle dedicated tablet funded with %app_name% pre-installed.
acapela_explainer: Acapela 為語音生成提供優質合成語音。 Acapela 在 %app_name% 中為 iOS、Android 和 Windows 配音。 [[ Acapela provides premium synthesized voices for speech generation. Acapela voices in %app_name% for iOS, Android and Windows.
switch_explainer: %app_name% 的內置開關激活掃描將與一個或兩個開關動作一起工作。大多數（如果不是全部）藍牙開關應該通過鍵盤仿真與 %app_name% 一起使用，並且在 Windows 上，其他鍵盤樣式的開關也可以在用戶的首選項中進行配置。 [[ %app_name%'s built-in switch-activated scanning will work with one or two switch actions. Most if not all bluetooth switches should work with %app_name% via keyboard emulation, and on Windows other keyboard-style switches can also be configured in a user's preferences.
blue2_explainer: Blue2 開關適用於移動和 Windows 設備，並提供一鍵和兩鍵開關控制 [[ The Blue2 switch worked with mobile and Windows devices and provides one and two-button switch control
eye_trackers_explainer: 在 Windows 設備上，您可以下載並安裝 %app_name% 應用程序以將 %app_name% 與硬件眼動儀配合使用。一些眼動儀（EyeX 和 EyeTribe）目前具有原生集成，而其他眼動儀（Tobii、myGaze、eyetech 等）在光標模式下運行良好。可以在用戶的首選項中配置停留時間和激活距離等設置。 [[ On Windows devices, you can download and install the %app_name% app to use %app_name% with hardware eye trackers. Some eye trackers (EyeX and EyeTribe) currently have native integrations, while others (Tobii, myGaze, eyetech, etc.) work very well running in cursor mode. Settings like dwell time and activation distance can be configured in a user's preferences.
head_pointers_and_mice: 頭指針和鼠標 [[ Head Pointers and Mice
head_mouse_explainer: Windows 上的鼠標光標可以通過多種不同的界面來控制，包括一些標題指針和鼠標工具。這些應用程序和設備可以使用 %app_name% 的內置駐留跟踪進行配置，可在 Windows %app_name% 應用程序中使用。 [[ The mouse cursor on Windows can be controlled by many different kinds of interface, including some header pointers and head mouse tools. These apps and devices can be configured using %app_name%'s built-in dwell tracking, available in the Windows %app_name% app.
camera_mouse_explainer: Camera Mouse 是一款免費的頭部跟踪 Windows 應用程序，它使用計算機的攝像頭來控制鼠標光標。 [[ Camera Mouse is a free head-tracking Windows app that uses the computer's camera to control the mouse cursor.
bluetooth_speakers_explainer: 有些設備沒有足夠大的揚聲器，或者揚聲器指向錯誤的方向，因此它們無法幫助溝通者有效地說話。藍牙音箱可以和%app_name%一起使用，方便交流，甚至讓%app_name%的使用更有趣。 [[ Some devices don't have loud enough speakers, or have speakers that point the wrong direction so they don't help a communicator speak effectively. Bluetooth speakers can be used with %app_name% to facilitate communication, and even to make using %app_name% just a little more fun.
clipster_explainer: ION Clipster 是一款夾式藍牙揚聲器，可以連接到設備並提供額外的音量和直接從通信器傳出的聲音。 [[ ION Clipster is a clip-on bluetooth speaker that can connect to devices and provide additional volume and direct sound out in from of the communicator.
bluebee_explainer: Bluebee Pals 是可愛的毛絨玩具，內置藍牙揚聲器，說話時嘴巴會動。它們可以成為培養溝通者的重要強化工具。 [[ Bluebee Pals are cute stuffed animals with a built-in bluetooth speaker whose mouths move as they speak. They can be a great reinforcement tool for developing communicators.
keyguard_explainer: 對於某些用戶來說，他們可能很難將手指放在正確的按鈕上。鍵盤保護可以幫助他們導航到正確的位置，一些公司可以為幾乎任何 %app_name% 板配置創建自定義鍵盤保護。 [[ For some users it can be hard to get their fingers down on the right buttons. Keyguards can help them navigate to the right place, and some companies can create custom keyguards for just about any %app_name% board configuration.
lasered_pics_explainer: Lasered Pics 可以為許多不同的平板電腦和設備創建自定義鍵盤保護。通過從設備向他們發送屏幕截圖，他們可以支持許多 %app_name% 配置。 [[ Lasered Pics can create custom keyguards for many different tablets and devices. By sending them a screenshot from the device they can support many %app_name% configurations.
frs_keyguards_explainer: Forbes AAC 可以為與 ProSlate 專用平板電腦配合使用的不同 %app_name% 配置創建自定義鍵盤保護。 [[ Forbes AAC can create custom keyguards for different %app_name% configurations that work with their ProSlate dedicated tablets.

privacy_intro: LingoLinq LLC（以下簡稱「LingoLinq」、「我們」或「我們的」）非常重視您的隱私。本隱私權政策適用於我們的網站 (www.lingolinq.com) 以及 LingoLinq 的產品、軟體和應用程式（統稱為「產品」）。 [[ LingoLinq LLC ("LingoLinq," "we," "us," or "our") is deeply committed to your privacy. This Privacy Policy applies to our website (www.lingolinq.com) and LingoLinq's products, software, and applications (collectively, the "Product").
privacy_compliance: 由於 LingoLinq 在全球教育和醫療領域得到應用，我們採取了嚴格的資料保護措施，以符合當地、聯邦和國際法規，包括 COPPA、FERPA、HIPAA、GDPR（歐洲）和 CCPA（加州）。 [[ Because LingoLinq is utilized globally in educational and medical settings, we employ stringent data protection practices designed to comply with local, federal, and international regulations, including COPPA, FERPA, HIPAA, GDPR (Europe), and CCPA (California).
privacy_philosophy: 我們的核心隱私理念很簡單：除非您開啟了需要保留對話記錄的功能，否則我們不會儲存您的對話記錄。我們收集的任何用於改進產品的使用資料都經過嚴格匿名化處理，並且需要您明確同意。例外情況列於下方的「隱私權保障」部分，您可以隨時關閉這些例外情況。 [[ Our core privacy philosophy is simple: we do not keep transcripts of your conversations unless you switch on a feature that needs them, and any usage data we collect to improve our Product is strictly anonymized and requires your explicit opt-in. The exceptions are listed under the "Private Thoughts" Guarantee below, and each one can be switched off.
privacy_agreement: 使用本產品即表示您同意我們按照本政策所述的方式收集和使用您的資訊。 [[ By using the Product, you agree to the collection and use of your information as described in this policy.
privacy_guarantee_heading: 1. LingoLinq 隱私保障 [[ 1. The LingoLinq Privacy Guarantee
privacy_guarantee_thoughts_heading: 「私密想法」保障： [[ The "Private Thoughts" Guarantee:
privacy_guarantee_thoughts: LingoLinq 預設不會儲存交流者的對話記錄。但有兩個例外，我們寧願明確說明，而不是隱瞞。首先是使用日誌記錄：此功能預設為關閉，除非您手動開啟。開啟此功能需要單獨的確認步驟。開啟後，我們會加密儲存每次發言的文字和每次按鍵的標籤，並據此產生報告和統計資料。其次是 AI 字詞預測：開啟此功能後，我們會記錄每次實際到達 AI 供應商的預測請求。記錄包含最多 200 個字元的句子內容，我們會先過濾掉可辨識的辨識資訊。記錄僅用於顯示發送的內容和時間，我們自身快取中回應的請求不會被記錄。您可以在偏好設定中關閉這些功能。除此之外，您的想法和文字完全屬於您。 [[ By default LingoLinq does not keep transcripts of a communicator's conversations. There are two exceptions, which we would rather state plainly than bury. First, usage logging: this is off unless you turn it on, and turning it on takes a separate confirmation step, but while it is on we store the text of each utterance and the label of each button pressed, encrypted, and we produce reports and statistics from them. Second, AI word prediction: while it is on, each prediction request that actually reaches the AI vendor is recorded, and that record includes up to 200 characters of the sentence being composed, with identifying details we can detect filtered out first; it is kept to show what was sent and when, and requests we answer from our own cache are not recorded. Each of these can be switched off in your preferences. Apart from them, your thoughts and words are yours alone.

pp_intro_1: LingoLinq 是一款功能強大、靈活的溝通應用程式和系統，它能夠幫助溝通者及其團隊制定個人化的語言學習策略，並實現高效溝通。由於 LingoLinq 被應用於醫療和教育領域，且使用者年齡跨度較大，因此我們高度重視州和聯邦法規，例如 FERPA、HIPAA 和 COPPA 等，並積極追蹤與這些法規相關的政策。遵守隱私和安全法規需要 LingoLinq 與使用我們軟體的機構通力合作。為此，我們制定了這套聲明和最佳實踐，以防止個人資訊洩露給任何不應訪問的人員。 [[ LingoLinq is a powerful, flexible communication app and system that enables communicators and the teams around them to develop a personalized language learning strategy and to communicate effectively. Because LingoLinq is used in medical and educational settings for different ages of user, we are sensitive to state and federal regulations like FERPA, HIPAA, COPPA, etc. and work hard to track policies related to those regulations. Compliance with privacy and security regulations requires collaboration between LingoLinq and the institutions that use our software. As such, we have compiled this set of assertions and best practices to prevent exposing personal information to anyone who shouldn't have access to it.
pp_intro_2: LingoLinq 使用雲端技術備份、同步和報告溝通者的詞彙量和活動。我們這樣做是為了方便使用者（提供備份和多設備支援），幫助使用者了解溝通者的進步，促進支援團隊之間的協作，增強組織的責任感，並掌握網站的整體趨勢。由於個人溝通訊息可能涉及敏感內容，我們非常重視用戶隱私。以下是我們的一些保護策略和最佳實踐，您可以遵循這些策略和實踐，以確保溝通者的隱私和權利受到尊重。提供這些資訊旨在幫助組織進行決策和培訓，並且可能會隨時間而變化。 [[ LingoLinq uses the cloud to back up, synchronize, and report on a communicator's vocabulary and activities. We do this to provide convenience for users (backup and multi-device support), insights on communicator progress, collaboration across support teams, accountability for organizations, and general trends across the site. Because of the potentially sensitive nature of the information related to an individual's communication, we take user privacy very seriously. Below are some of our protection strategies, and best practices that you can follow to ensure the privacy and rights of the communicator are respected. The information is provided to help organizations in their decision-making and training processes, and may change over time.

faq_ai_boards_q: 我可以利用AI板生成功能創建哪些有趣且引人入勝的演講板？ [[ What are some interesting and engaging speech boards I can create using AI board generation?
faq_ai_boards_p1: AI 看板產生功能可以將簡短描述轉換為可編輯的初始佈局——您可以像編輯其他看板一樣，對按鈕、分組和路徑進行精細調整。最吸引人的看板都與現實生活緊密相關：例如特定的日常安排、地點、人物或目標，以及溝通者當週實際想要使用的詞彙。 [[ AI board generation turns a short description into a starter layout you can edit—buttons, groups, and paths you refine like any other board. The most engaging boards are tied to real life: a specific routine, place, person, or goal, with vocabulary the communicator will actually want to use that week.
faq_ai_boards_p2: 試著引導學生描述情境，而不僅僅是詞彙類別。不要只列出“食物詞彙”，而是描述“在食堂點午餐”或“放學後選擇零食”。將核心詞彙（想要、幫助、更多、停止）與特定情境的邊緣詞彙（過敏、辛辣、金融卡、隊友）混合使用。這種平衡能讓詞彙板在對話中發揮作用，而不僅僅是一個靜態的詞彙表。 [[ Try prompting for situations, not just categories. Instead of only "food words," describe "ordering lunch in the cafeteria" or "choosing a snack after school." Mix core words (want, help, more, stop) with fringe words for that moment (allergy, spicy, debit card, teammate). That balance keeps boards useful in conversation, not just as a static word list.
faq_ai_boards_list_intro: 適用於課堂和診所的良好理念： [[ Ideas that work well in classrooms and clinics:
faq_ai_boards_li_1: 日常生活：早晨例行活動、家事、作業、就寢－每一項都有一組可預測的短語。 [[ Daily living: morning routine, chores, homework, bedtime—each with a small set of predictable phrases.
faq_ai_boards_li_2: 社會參與：操場遊戲、俱樂部會議、與家人視訊通話、與鄰居閒聊。 [[ Social participation: playground games, club meetings, video calls with family, small talk with neighbors.
faq_ai_boards_li_3: 社區服務：雜貨店、餐廳、藥局、圖書館——問題、選擇和解決問題的腳本。 [[ Community access: grocery store, restaurant, pharmacy, library—scripts for questions, choices, and problem-solving.
faq_ai_boards_li_4: 學習內容：單元科學詞彙、數學討論（估算、比較、證明）、實地考察安全與參與。 [[ Learning: science vocabulary for a unit, math talk (estimate, compare, prove), field trip safety and participation.
faq_ai_boards_li_5: 遊戲與嗜好：喜愛的遊戲規則和輪次、體育加油口號、藝術或音樂課程請求。 [[ Play and hobbies: rules and turns for favorite games, sports cheers, art or music lesson requests.
faq_ai_boards_li_6: 調節與健康：鎮靜選擇、疼痛或舒適度等級、症狀解釋、過敏及藥物用語。 [[ Regulation and health: calming choices, pain or comfort scale, explaining symptoms, allergy and medication phrases.
faq_ai_boards_p3: 生成後，進行徹底的編輯：用溝通者的語氣重命名按鈕，交換符號以便快速閱讀，並連結回穩定的主介面或備用面板。先從本月一個重要的場景入手，然後在感覺舒適後進行複製和調整。 [[ After generation, edit ruthlessly: rename buttons in the communicator's voice, swap symbols so they read quickly, and link back to a stable home or backup board. Start with one situation that matters this month, then duplicate and adapt once it feels comfortable.
faq_aac_q: 什麼是輔助溝通系統（AAC）？ （家長及照顧者簡明指引） [[ What Is AAC? (A Simple Guide for Parents & Caregivers)
faq_aac_intro_p1: 如果您的孩子或您關心的人有語言障礙，您可能聽說過輔助溝通系統（AAC）。一開始可能會覺得難以理解，但AAC的本質是幫助人們以最適合他們的方式進行溝通。 [[ If your child—or someone you care for—has difficulty speaking, you may have heard the term AAC. It can feel overwhelming at first, but AAC is simply about helping people communicate in the way that works best for them.
faq_aac_intro_p2: 本指南將帶您了解 AAC 的含義、適用人群、不同類型以及 LingoLinq 等工具如何融入其中。 [[ This guide will walk you through what AAC means, who it’s for, the different types available, and how tools like LingoLinq fit into the picture.
faq_aac_sub_what_stand: AAC是什麼的縮寫？ [[ What Does AAC Stand For?
faq_aac_stand_for_line: AAC 代表輔助和替代溝通。 [[ AAC stands for Augmentative and Alternative Communication.
faq_aac_def_augmentative_line: 增強型 = 在言語中添加 [[ Augmentative = adding to speech
faq_aac_def_alternative_line: 替代方案 = 替換演講 [[ Alternative = replacing speech
faq_aac_simple_terms_lead: 簡單來說： [[ In simple terms:
faq_aac_simple_body: AAC（輔助溝通系統）包括任何能夠幫助說話困難或無法說話的人表達自己的溝通方式。 [[ AAC includes any method of communication that helps someone express themselves if speaking is difficult or not possible.
faq_aac_not_just: AAC 不僅適用於「不會說話」的人，也適用於任何需要幫助以更有效溝通的人。 [[ AAC is not just for people who “can’t talk”—it’s for anyone who needs support communicating more effectively.
faq_aac_sub_who: AAC適用於哪些人？ [[ Who Is AAC For?
faq_aac_who_intro: 輔助溝通系統（AAC）適用於所有年齡層的人群，從幼兒到成人。它可以為以下人群提供支援： [[ AAC is used by people of all ages, from young children to adults. It can support individuals with:
faq_aac_who_li_apraxia: 言語失用症 [[ Apraxia of speech
faq_aac_who_li_stroke: 中風或腦損傷 [[ Stroke or brain injury
faq_aac_who_li_als: 肌萎縮側索硬化症或其他退化性疾病 [[ ALS or other degenerative conditions
faq_aac_who_li_temp: 暫時性失語症（受傷、手術等） [[ Temporary speech loss (injury, surgery, etc.)
faq_aac_who_duration: 有些人短期使用輔助溝通設備，有些人則終生依賴它。 [[ Some people use AAC short-term, while others rely on it throughout their lives.
faq_aac_important_label: 重要提示 [[ Important to know
faq_aac_important_label_colon: 重要須知： [[ Important to know:
faq_aac_important_body: 使用輔助溝通系統並不會阻礙一個人學習說話。在很多情況下，它實際上能夠支援和促進語言發展。 [[ Using AAC does not stop someone from learning to speak. In many cases, it actually supports and improves speech development.
faq_aac_sub_types: 輔助溝通系統的類型 [[ Types of AAC
faq_aac_types_intro: AAC 可分為兩大類： [[ AAC can be broken into two main categories:
faq_aac_sub_low_tech: 1. 無技術/低技術輔助溝通系統 [[ 1. No-Tech / Low-Tech AAC
faq_aac_low_tech_desc: 這些不需要電子元件。 [[ These do not require electronics.
faq_aac_low_ex_gestures: 手勢（指點、點頭） [[ Gestures (pointing, nodding)
faq_aac_low_ex_books: 印刷通訊手冊 [[ Printed communication books
faq_aac_low_pro_1: 簡單可靠 [[ Simple and reliable
faq_aac_low_pro_2: 無需電池或安裝 [[ No batteries or setup
faq_aac_low_con_2: 更難快速適應 [[ Harder to adapt quickly
faq_aac_sub_high_tech: 2. 高科技輔助空調 [[ 2. High-Tech AAC
faq_aac_high_tech_desc: 這些是幫助人們溝通的電子工具或應用程式。 [[ These are electronic tools or apps that help people communicate.
faq_aac_high_ex_sgd: 語音生成設備（SGD） [[ Speech-generating devices (SGDs)
faq_aac_high_ex_tablet: 基於平板電腦的 AAC 應用 [[ Tablet-based AAC apps
faq_aac_high_ex_gaze: 眼動追蹤或基於注視的系統 [[ Eye-tracking or gaze-based systems
faq_aac_high_pro_1: 更大的詞彙量 [[ Larger vocabulary
faq_aac_high_pro_2: 可以生成語音 [[ Can generate speech
faq_aac_high_con_1: 需要設定和學習 [[ Requires setup and learning
faq_aac_high_con_2: 可能更貴 [[ May be more expensive
faq_aac_sub_how_works: AAC的實際工作原理 [[ How AAC Actually Works
faq_aac_how_p1: 大多數 AAC 系統都是圍繞著通訊板建構的——通訊板由按鈕、符號或文字組成。 [[ Most AAC systems are built around a communication board—a layout of buttons, symbols, or words.

privacy_special_coppa_v2: 13歲以下兒童只有在獲得可驗證的家長同意後方可使用LingoLinq。我們僅在LingoLinq用於學校課程且不包含任何人工智慧功能、不進行使用者畫像分析、不投放廣告的情況下，接受學校官員根據《家庭教育權利和隱私法案》(FERPA) 出具的授權，以代替直接的家長同意。 13歲以下兒童使用LingoLinq的任何人工智慧功能，包括人工智慧輔助生成棋盤和人工智慧單字預測，均需根據《美國聯邦法規》第16篇第312部分獲得可驗證的家長同意，無論其是否在校就讀。如果我們發現已在未獲得必要同意的情況下收集了13歲以下兒童的個人信息，我們將立即刪除這些信息。 [[ Children under 13 may only use LingoLinq with verifiable parental consent. We accept a FERPA school-official authorization in place of direct parental consent only for the limited, school-curriculum use of LingoLinq with no AI features, no profiling, and no advertising. Any use of LingoLinq's AI features by a child under 13, including AI-assisted board generation and AI word prediction, requires verifiable parental consent under 16 CFR Part 312, regardless of school enrollment. If we learn we have collected personal information from a child under 13 without the required consent, we will delete it promptly.
privacy_special_ai_consent_intro: 由於使用 LingoLinq 的字詞預測功能會將部分資訊傳送給外部人工智慧公司，因此，除了上述通用家長同意書之外，我們還需要您單獨簽署一份針對該功能的第二次人工智慧資料共享同意書。目前，人工智慧產生的評估摘要功能處於停用狀態，不會向任何人工智慧公司發送任何資訊；該功能會在我們自己的系統中產生草稿，啟用即時人工智慧評估摘要功能需要更新資訊揭露並獲得新的同意書，之後才會發送任何內容。您無需同意此第二次同意書即可使用 LingoLinq 的其他功能。請參閱我們的[此處插入連結]。 [[ Because using LingoLinq's word prediction sends some information to an outside AI company, we ask for a separate, second AI data-sharing consent beyond the general parental consent described above, specific to that feature. AI-drafted evaluation summaries are currently inactive and send nothing to any AI company; that feature produces a draft on our own systems instead, and turning on live AI evaluation summaries would require an updated disclosure and a fresh consent before anything is sent. You do not have to agree to this second consent to use the rest of LingoLinq. See our
privacy_security_retention_intro: 我們僅在實現收集目的所需的時間內保留個人數據，並根據我們的數據保留計劃，對不同類別的數據保留期限進行劃分。 [[ We retain personal data only as long as necessary for the purpose it was collected, with category-specific windows that align with our Data Retention Schedule.
privacy_security_retention_active: 活躍帳戶資料：保留至帳戶生命週期結束，加上最多 2 年的連續不活動期，之後帳戶將被軟體刪除並排隊等待清除。 [[ Active account data: retained for the life of the account, plus up to 2 years of continuous inactivity, after which the account is soft-deleted and queued for purge.
privacy_security_retention_inactive: 不活躍帳戶：12 個月未使用的帳戶將被標記為自動刪除，但對於意外刪除，將有 10 天的寬限期。 [[ Inactive accounts: accounts inactive for 12 months are flagged for automatic deletion, subject to a 10-day grace period for accidental deletions.
privacy_security_retention_ai_logs: AI 請求日誌：稽核記錄（AiApiLog）保留 2 年；這些記錄中的 IP 位址在 90 天後被刪除。 [[ AI request logs: the audit record (AiApiLog) is retained for 2 years; IP addresses on those records are redacted at 90 days.
privacy_security_retention_ai_eu: 我們已確認帳戶位於歐盟境內，並已安排對其中的人工智慧請求日誌進行為期五年的清理，但目前尚無任何記錄因年代久遠而被清除。此前，我們曾以歐盟人工智慧法第50條作為此次清理期限的依據。但這是錯誤的：第50條是一項透明度條款，並未規定記錄保存期限。目前，我們正在與律師審查此次清理期限的正確依據和具體時間。 [[ AI request logs for accounts we have confirmed are in the European Union: a 5-year purge is scheduled and running, though no record is yet old enough for it to have removed anything. We previously gave EU AI Act Article 50 as the reason for this window. That was wrong: Article 50 is a transparency provision and sets no record-keeping period. The correct basis and the length of this window are under review with our lawyers.
privacy_security_retention_voice: 語音和音訊錄製（您錄製的按鈕聲音）：在使用者帳戶存在期間保留，並在帳戶刪除時刪除。 [[ Voice and audio recordings (button sounds you record): retained for the life of the user account and deleted when the account is deleted.
privacy_security_retention_dwell: 停留時間、眼動追蹤和頭部追蹤時間資料（儲存在通訊日誌中）：預設保留 3 年，可根據使用者或組織配置為更短的視窗期。 [[ Dwell, eye-gaze, and head-tracking timing data (stored within communication logs): retained for 3 years by default, configurable to a shorter window per user or organization.
privacy_security_retention_tenant: 學校和學區租戶資料：在客戶合約結束後 90 天內刪除，除非資料處理附錄中規定了更短的期限。 [[ School and district tenant data: deleted within 90 days after the customer contract ends, unless a shorter window is specified in the data processing addendum.
privacy_security_retention_children: 兒童資料（13歲以下使用者）：家長可隨時控制；使用者年滿18歲或連續兩年未使用帳戶後（以較早者為準）資料將自動刪除。經核實的家長刪除請求將在30天內處理完畢。 [[ Children's data (users under 13): parent-controllable at any time; automatically purged at age 18 or after 2 years of inactivity, whichever is sooner. Verified parental deletion requests are processed within 30 days.
privacy_security_retention_backups: 備份遵循 35 天滾動復原視窗；如果記錄被刪除，我們的保留策略會在任何復原作業後重新套用刪除操作。完整的計劃，包括每個類別的法律依據和刪除機制，可向我們的資料隱私團隊索取。 [[ Backups follow a 35-day rolling window for operational recovery; if a record is deleted, our retention jobs re-apply the deletion after any restore. The full schedule, including legal basis and deletion mechanism for each category, is available on request from our Data Privacy Team.

coaching_lead: 以實證為基礎的合作夥伴策略，以幫助實現這一目標。 [[ Evidence-based partner strategies to help reach this goal.
coaching_model_title: 設備上的模型 [[ Model on the device
coaching_model_body: 說話時，用手指輕敲AAC系統上的目標字眼－示範，而不是詢問。這就是輔助語言刺激法，AAC建模策略的黃金標準。 [[ Tap target words on the AAC system while you speak — show, don't ask. This is Aided Language Stimulation, the gold-standard AAC modeling strategy.
coaching_wait_title: 至少等待 10 秒 [[ Wait at least 10 seconds
coaching_wait_body: 示範結束後，請靜默暫停10秒以上。使用輔助溝通設備（AAC）的使用者通常需要額外的時間來規劃和執行他們的回應。 [[ After modeling, pause silently for 10+ seconds. AAC users often need extra processing time to plan and execute their response.
coaching_routines_title: 融入日常生活中 [[ Embed in daily routines
coaching_routines_body: 將目標融入吃零食時間、過渡環節、遊戲環節和準備環節——這些自然而然的時刻，正是這個詞在房間裡最有用的時刻。 [[ Build the target into snack time, transitions, play, and getting ready — natural moments where the word is the most useful one in the room.
coaching_generalize_title: 適用於所有合作夥伴和地點 [[ Generalize across partners and places
coaching_generalize_body: 確保這項技能能在不同的溝通夥伴之間、不同的場合、不同的活動中展現出來——而不僅僅是在治療中。 [[ Make sure the skill shows up with different communication partners, in different settings, across different activities — not just in therapy.
coaching_celebrate_title: 重視努力，而非完美。 [[ Reinforce effort, not perfection

home_tour_nav_title: 您的主導航 [[ Your main navigation
home_tour_nav_text: 從頂部導覽列切換「首頁」、「看板」、「報告」和「其他」選項。 [[ Switch between Home, Boards, Reports, and Extras from this top nav.
home_tour_page_home_text: 您的儀表板主頁－從上次離開的地方繼續操作，開啟語音模式，並一目了然地存取您最常用的工具。 [[ Your dashboard home — pick up where you left off, open Speak Mode, and reach your most-used tools at a glance.
home_tour_page_boards_text: 瀏覽、建立和整理您的溝通看板（頁面集）。打開任何看板即可查看或編輯。 [[ Browse, create, and organize your communication boards (page-sets). Open any board to view or edit it.
home_tour_page_reports_text: 追蹤使用情況和進度－您所支援人員的溝通活動和文字資料。 [[ Track usage and progress — communication activity and word data for the people you support.
home_tour_page_extras_text: 遊戲、課程、帳戶設定和其他實用工具都在這裡，隨時滿足您的需求。 [[ Games, lessons, account settings, and other helpful tools live here whenever you need them.
home_tour_caseload_text: 直接跳到您支援的物件。新增備註、進行快速評估或以語音模式進行示範。 [[ Jump straight to the people you support. Add a note, run a quick assessment, or model in speak mode.
home_tour_speak_title: 開啟說話模式 [[ Open Speak Mode
home_tour_speak_text: 繼續說話功能會將您的主面板開啟為通訊模式，方便日常使用。 [[ Continue Speaking opens your home board in communication mode, ready for everyday use.
home_tour_boards_title: 管理您的看板 [[ Manage your boards
home_tour_boards_text: 建立、瀏覽和整理看板。您的主頁看板會固定在看板條的最前面。 [[ Create, browse, and organize boards. Your home board is pinned at the front of the strip.
home_tour_extras_title: 更多工具請參見“附加功能” [[ More tools in Extras
home_tour_extras_text: 您可以在「附加功能」中隨時找到遊戲、課程、帳戶設定等內容。 [[ Find games, lessons, account settings, and more under Extras whenever you need them.
home_tour_orgs_title: 管理您的組織 [[ Manage your organizations
home_tour_orgs_text: 如果您管理一個或多個 LingoLinq 組織，請點擊此處管理成員、房間和授權。 [[ If you administer one or more LingoLinq organizations, jump in here to manage members, rooms, and licenses.
home_tour_done_text: 這就是本次導覽。您可以隨時點擊儀錶板頂部的「開始導覽」按鈕重新觀看。 [[ That's the tour. You can revisit it anytime from the Take a tour button at the top of the dashboard.
home_board_assign_not_found: 我們找不到推薦的板塊。請從下方選擇一個。 [[ We couldn't find the recommended home board. Please pick one below.
preparing_your_board: 準備您的董事會 [[ Preparing your Board
loading_board_layout: 正在載入現代電路板佈局 [[ Loading the modern board layout
beta_welcome_greeting_named: 嗨，%{name}，很高興你來到這裡。 [[ Hi %{name}, we're glad you're here.
beta_welcome_greeting_generic: 我們非常高興您能來幫助我們建立 LingoLinq。 [[ We're so glad you're here to help us build LingoLinq.
beta_welcome_intro: 感謝您參與測試版。我們與 AAC 使用者、治療師、教師和家庭共同開發 LingoLinq，您的回饋有助於我們改進最終產品。 [[ Thanks for joining the beta. We're building LingoLinq with AAC users, therapists, teachers, and families, and your feedback helps us improve what we ship.
beta_welcome_explore_title: 我們可以一起探索的兩種方式 [[ Two ways we can explore together
beta_welcome_explore_speak_title: 說話、玩耍和探索 [[ Speak, play & discover
beta_welcome_explore_speak_body: 您已獲得漫遊許可！盡情探索、嘗試，找到您喜歡的交談、分享和溝通方式。 [[ You have an official license to roam! Explore, try things out, and find how you like to talk, share, and communicate.
beta_welcome_explore_missions_body: 每週我們都會分享一個簡短的活動，以便我們可以一起練習使用不同的功能。 [[ Each week we'll share a short activity so we can practice using different features together.
beta_welcome_step_tour_title: 觀看快速導覽 [[ Watch the quick tour
beta_welcome_step_tour_body: 我們製作了一個簡短的視頻，向您展示所有功能是如何運作的，幫助您安心使用。 [[ We put together a short video to show how everything works and help you feel at ease.
beta_welcome_step_popups_title: 沿途彈出窗口 [[ Pop-ups along the way
beta_welcome_step_popups_body: 整個應用過程中，都會有貼心的提示訊息解釋各項功能，就像從一開始就為你準備了一份速查表。 [[ Throughout the app, helpful messages explain features as you go. Like a cheat sheet from day one.
beta_welcome_step_agreement_title: 一些簡單的家務 [[ A quick bit of housekeeping
beta_welcome_step_agreement_body: 下一個頁面將出現一份簡短的英文協議。請仔細閱讀並確認無誤後再接受，如有任何疑問，請與我們聯絡。 [[ On the next screen you'll see a short agreement in plain English. Please review it and accept when you're ready, or contact us with any questions.
beta_welcome_step_signed_in_title: 您已登入 [[ You're signed in
beta_welcome_step_signed_in_body: 完成協議後，您將進入 LingoLinq 並可以立即開始探索。 [[ When you finish the agreement, you'll head into LingoLinq and can start exploring right away.
beta_welcome_feedback_title: 如何分享你的想法 [[ How to share your thoughts
beta_welcome_feedback_body: 如果您發現問題、發現漏洞或有任何想法，請使用應用程式內的「Beta 回饋」按鈕。任何細節都值得推薦！ [[ If you find a problem, catch a bug, or have an idea, use the Beta Feedback button inside the app. No detail is too small!
beta_welcome_signoff: 感謝你幫助我們塑造這種新的聲音，並成為我們團隊的重要成員！ [[ Thank you for helping us shape this new voice and being a vital part of our crew!
beta_welcome_team: LingoLinq 團隊 [[ The LingoLinq Team
beta_agreement_title: LingoLinq Beta 測試協議 [[ LingoLinq Beta Test Agreement
beta_agreement_subtitle: 面向測試使用者群體的簡單易懂的條款。請在繼續之前閱讀。 [[ Plain-language terms for our beta community. Please read before you continue.
beta_agreement_lead: 歡迎加入團隊！在開始共同測試 LingoLinq 之前，請先閱讀這份簡短的協議。繼續操作即表示您同意以下條款： [[ Welcome to the team! Before we start testing LingoLinq together, please look over this short agreement. By continuing, you agree to these terms:
beta_agreement_open_source_title: 開源與共享 [[ Open source & sharing
beta_agreement_share_title: 分享你的旅程： [[ Share your journey:
beta_agreement_share_body: LingoLinq 是開源軟體。我們鼓勵您分享螢幕截圖、影片和評論，以幫助提升用戶熱情。 [[ LingoLinq is open source. We encourage you to share screenshots, videos, and reviews to help build excitement.
beta_agreement_ideas_body: 您的建議和錯誤報告將有助於改進 LingoLinq，使每個人都能從中受益，而您無需承擔任何額外義務。 [[ Suggestions and bug reports may be used to improve LingoLinq for everyone, without extra obligations to you.
beta_agreement_privacy_title: 隱私與資料安全 [[ Privacy & keeping data safe
beta_agreement_privacy_body: 為了以最佳方式打造您的語音體驗，我們需要了解它在實際應用中的運作方式。我們的工程師可能會使用通訊和後台數據（遙測數據）來修復漏洞並提升速度。我們會根據我們的隱私權聲明保護這些資料。 [[ To build your voice in the best way possible, we need to understand how it works in real-world situations. Our engineers may use communication and background data (telemetry) to fix bugs and improve speed. We protect this data in accordance with our Privacy Notice.
beta_agreement_logs_body: 所有用於故障排除的通訊日誌在工程師查看之前都會移除姓名和個人資料資訊。 [[ Any communication logs reviewed for troubleshooting are stripped of names and personal profiles before engineers see them.
beta_agreement_parents_title: 家長和監護人： [[ Parents & guardians:
beta_agreement_parents_body: 如果您是 13 歲以下測試者的家長，請在註冊時填寫我們的可驗證家長同意書。 [[ If you are a parent of a tester under 13, complete our Verifiable Parental Consent during registration.
beta_agreement_schools_body: 在教育機構中，應確保獲得學區批准或家長同意，以符合 FERPA 規定。 [[ In educational settings, ensure proper district approval or parental consent for FERPA compliance.
beta_agreement_clinicians_title: 臨床醫師和語言治療師： [[ Clinicians & SLPs:
beta_agreement_clinicians_body: 在簽署業務夥伴協議 (BAA) 之前，請勿輸入真實的患者個人健康資訊 (PHI)。聯絡方式 [[ Do not input real patient PHI until a BAA is signed. Contact
beta_agreement_forgotten_title: 你有權利被遺忘 [[ Your right to be forgotten
beta_agreement_forgotten_body: 刪除您的帳戶。我們會在 48 小時內永久刪除您的個人識別資訊 (PII)，並且僅保留無法與您關聯的資料。 [[ to delete your account. We permanently delete your PII within 48 hours and only keep data that cannot be linked back to you.
beta_agreement_safety_title: 輔助溝通設備使用者的重要安全提示 [[ Important safety note for AAC users
beta_agreement_safety_lead: 隨時準備好你的主要聲音： [[ Keep your main voice handy:
beta_agreement_safety_body: 這是預發布版本軟體，可能存在漏洞或偶爾崩潰。測試期間，請您隨身攜帶主要通訊設備作為備用。請勿在測試階段將 LingoLinq 作為唯一的通訊方式。 [[ This is pre-release software — it may have bugs or occasionally crash. Please keep your primary communication device with you as a backup while we test. Do not rely on LingoLinq as your only way to talk during this beta phase.
beta_agreement_legal_title: 法律方面的內容 [[ The legal stuff
beta_agreement_legal_body: 您需自行承擔使用此測試版本的風險。 LingoLinq 以原樣提供，不提供任何保證。本協議有效期至我們正式發布或 Beta 測試計劃結束為止。 [[ You use this test version at your own risk. LingoLinq is provided as-is without warranties. This agreement stays in place until our official launch or until the beta program ends.
beta_agreement_thanks: 感謝您與我們合作開發 LingoLinq！ [[ Thank you for partnering with us to build LingoLinq!
beta_agreement_accept: 我已閱讀並接受 Beta 測試協議。 [[ I have read and accept the Beta Test Agreement.
boards_empty_subtitle: 建立您的第一個看板，它將顯示在這裡。 [[ Create your first board and it'll appear here.
english_first_board_hint: 為了確保符號顏色準確，棋盤首先以英文創建。儲存後即可進行翻譯。 [[ Boards are created in English first for accurate symbol colors. You can translate after saving.
home_tour_trigger_aria: 參觀儀錶板 [[ Take a tour of the dashboard
assign_home_board_for_me: 請為我分配一個家庭委員會 [[ Assign a Home Board For Me
welcome_fill_out_subscription3: 歡迎！您的帳戶包含 2 個月的免費雲端服務附加功能－在正式購買前試用 %app_name%，或選擇一個方案立即開始使用。 [[ Welcome! Your account includes 2 free months of cloud extras — try %app_name% before committing, or pick a plan to start right away.
board_already_translated_prompt: 此留言板已包含該語言的翻譯。使用「切換到現有翻譯」可設定為預設顯示和朗讀語言。若要變更語言，請開啟原始英文留言板副本或從留言板選單使用「切換語言」功能。 [[ This board already has translations for this language. Use Switch to Existing Translation to make it the default display and speak language. To change languages, open the original English board copy or use Switch Language from the board menu.
board_already_in_source_language: 此電路板已設定為 %{language} 語言。若要查看其他語言，請使用電路板選單中的「切換語言」功能，或開啟此電路板的翻譯版本。 [[ This board is already in %{language}. To view another language, use Switch Language from the board menu or open a translated copy of this board.
telemetry_opt_in: 我同意允許收集匿名使用情況和性能數據（遙測數據），以幫助改進 LingoLinq。 [[ I agree to allow anonymous usage and performance data (telemetry) to be collected to help improve LingoLinq.
comms_log_opt_in: 我同意允許對匿名通訊日誌進行審查，以用於故障排除和應用程式改進。在任何工程師審查日誌之前，日誌中的姓名和個人資料資訊都會被完全移除。 [[ I agree to allow anonymized communication logs to be reviewed for troubleshooting and app improvement. Logs are fully stripped of names and personal profiles before any engineer reviews them.
register_consent_terms_prefix: 我已閱讀並同意以下內容： [[ I have read and agree to the
terms_of_use_and_license: 使用條款和授權協議 [[ Terms of Use and License Agreement
register_consent_terms_suffix: 並且有能力簽訂具有法律約束力的合約。 [[ , and am capable of binding to a legal contract.
register_consent_combined_prefix: 我已年滿13歲，已閱讀並同意以下條款： [[ I am at least 13 years old, have read and agree to the
register_consent_combined_suffix: 並且有能力簽訂具有法律約束力的合約。 [[ , and am capable of binding to a legal contract.
combined_consent_required_message: 您必須確認您的年齡並同意使用條款才能建立帳戶。 [[ You must confirm your age and agree to the Terms of Use to create an account.
org_default_beta_program_access_label: Beta 測試計劃存取權限，可取得啟動程式碼 [[ Beta program access for start codes
org_default_beta_program_access_toggle: 授予使用此組織提供的啟動碼註冊的新用戶測試版計劃存取權限 [[ Grant beta program access to new users who register with a start code from this organization
org_default_beta_program_access_hint: 關閉此功能後，使用此組織啟動碼註冊的使用者將看不到測試版歡迎流程。未使用啟動碼的自助註冊不受此設定影響。 [[ When off, users who sign up with this organization's start code will not see the beta welcome flow. Self-service signups without a start code are not affected by this setting.

weblinger_load_failed: 網路攝影機眼動追蹤庫載入失敗。請嘗試重新整理頁面或檢查網路連線。 [[ The webcam eye tracker library failed to load. Try refreshing the page or check your network connection.
weblinger_unavailable: 此瀏覽器中不支援網路攝影機眼動追蹤庫。 [[ The webcam eye tracker library is not available in this browser.

eyegaze_camera_setup_help: 進入語音模式或使用下方的「測試停留追蹤」功能時，攝影機將啟動。為獲得最佳精度，請先執行校準程序。 [[ The camera starts when you enter Speak Mode or use Test Dwell Tracking below. Run Calibrate first for the best accuracy.
eyegaze_weblinger_required: 網路攝影機眼動追蹤功能必須先成功載入追蹤器庫才能啟動。 [[ Webcam eye tracking cannot start until the tracker library loads successfully.
no_translations_to_save: 按鈕翻譯尚未儲存。請等待自動翻譯完成或手動輸入翻譯。 [[ No button translations to save. Wait for auto-translate to finish or enter translations manually.

eyegaze_tracking_failed: 眼動追蹤功能無法啟動。請檢查您的攝影機是否已連接，以及您是否已授予攝影機存取權限。 [[ Eye tracking could not start. Check that your camera is connected and that you allowed camera access.

beta_welcome_feedback_intro: 作為早期測試版成員，您的回饋將直接幫助塑造 AAC 使用者、家庭、治療師和教育工作者溝通工具的未來。 [[ As an early beta member, your feedback directly helps shape the future of communication tools for AAC users, families, therapists, and educators.
beta_welcome_mission_explore: 探索交流板 [[ Explore communication boards
beta_welcome_mission_tools: 嘗試使用語音、建模和導航工具 [[ Try speaking, modeling, and navigation tools

beta_welcome_mission_bugs: 請回報錯誤或任何感覺不正常的地方。 [[ Report bugs or anything that feels off
beta_welcome_mission_love: 也請告訴我們你喜歡什麼。 [[ Let us know what you love, too
beta_welcome_listening_pill: 我們正在傾聽 [[ We're listening
beta_welcome_listening_body: 每一個想法、每一個錯誤報告和每個建議都能幫助我們打造更人性化、更現代、更易用的溝通工具。細節決定成敗。 [[ Every idea, bug report, and observation helps us build communication tools that feel more human, modern, and accessible. No detail is too small.
beta_welcome_listening_hint: 靈感乍現時，應用程式內始終提供 Beta 回饋按鈕。 [[ The Beta Feedback button is always available inside the app whenever inspiration strikes.

privacy_beta_notice_heading: 測試版計劃通知 [[ Beta Program Notice
privacy_beta_notice_body: 本通知適用於 LingoLinq 測試版期間，並在正式發佈時失效。測試版期間，LingoLinq 為預發佈軟體，以「原樣」提供。請務必保持您主要的通訊方式可用，不要在此期間將 LingoLinq 作為唯一的通訊方式。如果您選擇加入，授權人員可能會查看匿名化的診斷使用數據，以修復錯誤並改進可訪問性；根據我們的“隱私想法保證”，我們不會查看通訊者產生的詞語或句子。對於 13 歲以下的用戶，在收集任何資料之前，必須獲得可驗證的家長同意（或，如果是學校使用，則需獲得學校官員的授權）。如果您將 LingoLinq 用於真實的患者訊息，您的機構應首先與我們簽訂業務夥伴協議 (BAA)；請聯絡我們簽署該協議。您可以隨時要求刪除您的帳戶，刪除時間遵循下文第 7 節所述的保留期限。 [[ This notice applies while LingoLinq is in beta and expires at general launch. During the beta, LingoLinq is pre-release software provided "as is." Please keep your primary communication method available at all times, and do not rely on LingoLinq as your only means of communication during this period. If you opt in, authorized staff may review anonymized, diagnostic usage data to fix bugs and improve accessibility; consistent with our Private Thoughts Guarantee, we do not review the words or sentences a communicator generates. For users under 13, verifiable parental consent (or, for school use, school-official authorization) is required before any data is collected. If you use LingoLinq with real patient information, your organization should have a Business Associate Agreement (BAA) in place with us first; contact us to execute one. You can request deletion of your account at any time, and deletion timing follows the retention windows described in Section 7 below.

privacy_sharing_ai: 用於人工智慧輔助的董事會建議、詞彙預測，以及（僅當言語治療師單獨提出要求時）人工智慧撰寫的評估摘要； [[ for AI-assisted board suggestions, word prediction, and, only when a speech-language pathologist takes a separate action to request it, AI-drafted evaluation summaries;
privacy_sharing_ai_vendors: 本通知所述的AI功能，包括AI輔助的看板建議、詞語預測和AI產生的評估摘要，均使用Anthropic公司託管在Amazon Bedrock上的Claude模型，該模型位於由LingoLinq控制的AWS帳戶內，並已簽署商業夥伴協議（看板建議和詞語預測使用Claude Haiku 4.5版本）。語音轉錄、語音合成和看板翻譯由獨立的Google服務處理；這些服務不受本段控制範圍的約束，並受其自身設定的約束。當您使用這些功能時，所需文字將透過Amazon Bedrock傳送至AWS，並由Anthropic公司的Claude模型進行處理。在發送任何內容之前，我們會自動過濾掉我們能夠檢測到的常見識別信息，例如姓名、電子郵件地址、電話號碼和帳戶標識符；此過濾並非完美無缺，我們將結果描述為已清理或匿名化的數據，而非正式的法律標準中移除所有識別信息。您可以在帳戶偏好設定中關閉您個人帳戶的 AI 功能；管理該帳戶的組織可以為所有其管理的帳戶關閉這些功能；對於 13 歲以下的兒童，這些功能將一直處於停用狀態，直到我們獲得必要的家長同意。目前，AI 產生的評估摘要功能處於停用狀態：請求產生摘要時，系統會在我們自己的系統中產生草稿，不會將任何內容傳送給任何 AI 供應商。如果我們啟用此功能，它將使用相同的 Amazon Bedrock 路徑和相同的過濾規則，並且我們會在發送任何評估資料之前更新此通知，以明確模型名稱。在 Amazon Bedrock 上，模型提供者完全不會收到此訊息，AWS 也聲明不會使用這些資訊來訓練任何模型。 AWS 可能會出於安全和防止濫用的目的在有限的時間內保留這些信息，因此我們目前不保證此路徑不會保留任何資料。 [[ The AI features described in this notice, meaning AI-assisted board suggestions, word prediction, and AI-drafted evaluation summaries, use Anthropic's Claude models hosted on Amazon Bedrock, inside a LingoLinq-controlled AWS account under a signed Business Associate Agreement (Claude Haiku 4.5 for board suggestions and word prediction). Separate Google services handle speech transcription, speech synthesis, and board translation; those are not covered by the controls in this paragraph and are governed by their own settings. When you use one of these features, the text it needs is sent to AWS through Amazon Bedrock for processing by an Anthropic Claude model. Before anything is sent, we automatically filter out common identifying details we can detect, such as names, emails, phone numbers, and account identifiers; this filter is not perfect, and we describe the result as scrubbed or pseudonymized data, not the formal legal standard for removing all identifying information. You can turn AI features off for your own account in your preferences, an organization that manages the account can turn them off for everyone it manages, and for a child under 13 they stay blocked until we have the required parental consent. AI-drafted evaluation summaries are inactive today: asking for one produces a draft written on our own systems, and nothing is sent to any AI vendor. If we switch that on, it would use the same Amazon Bedrock path and the same filtering, and we would update this notice to name the model before any evaluation data is sent. On Amazon Bedrock the model provider does not receive this information at all, and AWS states it is not used to train any model. AWS may retain it for a limited period for safety and abuse prevention, so we do not currently claim a zero-data-retention guarantee for this path.

It means making communication easier and faster, while preserving each person's voice, personality, and intent. We build for safety, trust, and privacy, so communicators and the people who support them can focus on what matters most: connecting with each other.
